title: The Martyrs Petition for Gurbakhsh Singh's Future Birth

blocks.text: The conclusion of the episode binds divine power, martyrdom, and future history together. For twelve years let the martyr's soul live in Divine presence becomes the request of the assembled martyrs, who ask that Gurbakhsh Singh remain in bliss for a time before returning again to earthly struggle.

The Guru's assurance also defines the nature of that return. Never is the Guru distinct from his Sikhs, and The whole Khalsa Panth would abide by his command because the authority granted to Gurbakhsh Singh is presented as an extension of the Guru's own strength within the Panth.

From there the narration turns toward the next historical movement. Asked in whose household he will be born, Gurbakhsh Singh is directed toward a brave warrior line, creating a hinge from this martyrdom episode into the following account of later Sikh resistance against Abdali and his allies.
